DESCRIPTION.general: General configuration for the Hard Drive Tools utility.
DESCRIPTION.general.temperature_warning: Drive temperature in degrees Celsius at which the utility reports a WARNING.
DESCRIPTION.general.wear_warning: Drive wear percentage at which the utility reports a WARNING.
DESCRIPTION.general.benchmark_size_mb: Amount of data in megabytes read during the non-destructive sequential read benchmark.
DESCRIPTION.general.disk_usage_warning: Filesystem usage percentage at which a filesystem on the selected drive is reported as WARNING.
